about: toktree's mutants (wf10 SL1): each law's mutant, killed by `ergo test` of its package (the examples runner); the case sample kills the summary's.

mutants.name: toktree-start-after-scan
mutants.rule: A token's start is its first byte, not the byte after it (law token.StartsAdvance).

mutants.name: toktree-close-is-punct
mutants.rule: A close brace is a Close token (law token.BracketsAreTheirOwnTokens through tree.GroupsAreOpens and the case sample).

mutants.name: toktree-group-keeps-stack
mutants.to: add(&tr, Group, opens[open], dense.PutList(&tr.pool, dense.Since(stack, marks[open])))
mutants.rule: A closed group takes its children off the stack, so each row has one parent (law tree.OneParentRootLast).

mutants.name: toktree-comment-is-leaf
mutants.rule: A comment is no row of the tree (law tree.GroupsAreOpens).

mutants.name: toktree-unclosed-group-dropped
mutants.rule: An unclosed group closes at the end (law tree.GroupsAreOpens).
